items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: He called Sam. Sam Allen, I think his name. He was a drummer. But he was a street drummer.

ctx.x: I was wondering a little bit about drummers. If you can remember any of the early drummers when you were a boy, before you learned drums even. Can you think of some of the fellows you maybe used to watch?

Oh, I used to watch old man Allen had a brother. He called Sam. Sam Allen, I think his name. He was a drummer. But he was a street drummer. He wasn't no St. Allen drummer. Well, drummers I knowed. I knowed Happy. Oh, yeah.
Was that Red Happy or Happy Goldston?
